parameters.content:
## Vera 05 · 03 Walk page API
Back end for the engineer's phone page on the visit day: load the checklist, take each capture (photo + GPS + status + voice), record the GPS trail, mark areas, record QR sticker scans, print stickers, finish the walk.

Generated from `n8n/mobilise/workflows.mjs`. Edit there and rebuild; edits made here are overwritten on the next import.
Each node's note says what it does and which guardrails it carries.

nodes.name: Walk page opens (GET)
nodes.notes:
The page asks for this site's checklist.
Guardrails: auth

nodes.name: Check walk link
nodes.notes:
Signed link, expires the day after the visit.
Guardrails: auth, error-out

nodes.name: Link valid?
nodes.notes: Forwarded or expired links stop here.

nodes.name: Respond 401

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "error": "unauthorized", "message": "This walk link has expired. Ask Vera for a new one." } }}

nodes.notes: Clear message for the page.

nodes.name: Load checklist for walk
nodes.notes:
Lines, statuses, papers already accepted, and the drawn areas.
Guardrails: error-out, retry

nodes.name: Send checklist
nodes.notes: The page caches it, so it works with no signal.

nodes.name: Walk page posts (POST)
nodes.notes:
capture / trail / finish / zone / spot / stickers (body.action). The page retries until it gets an answer.
Guardrails: auth

nodes.name: Check walk link
nodes.notes:
Same check.
Guardrails: auth, error-out

nodes.name: Link valid?
nodes.notes: Forwarded or expired links stop here.

nodes.name: Respond 401
nodes.notes: Page shows "ask for a new link".

nodes.name: Which action?
nodes.notes: Six kinds of post.

nodes.name: Load walk

parameters.query:
select w.id as walk_id, w.mobilisation_id, w.engineer_id, (select json_agg(code) from lines where mobilisation_id = w.mobilisation_id) as visit_lines,
  (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('area', area, 'name', name) || shape) from zones where mobilisation_id = w.mobilisation_id) as zones,
  (select row_to_json(e) from evidence e where e.capture_id::text = $2) as existing
from walks w where w.id = $1;

nodes.notes:
Lines, areas, and whether this capture was already saved.
Guardrails: error-out, retry

nodes.name: Validate capture
nodes.notes:
UUID per capture, known line code, size limits, sane GPS, phone clock vs server clock.
Guardrails: schema, error-out

nodes.name: Capture valid?
nodes.notes:
Bad input gets a 400 with the reasons.
Guardrails: schema

nodes.name: Respond 400
nodes.notes: The page shows the reason and keeps the capture.

nodes.name: Already saved?
nodes.notes:
Same capture_id = a retry from a weak network. Answer as before, save nothing twice.
Guardrails: idempotent

nodes.name: Respond saved (again)
nodes.notes: Idempotent answer.

nodes.name: Place on site map
nodes.notes: Phone fix (with its own ± metres) against the area drawn for this line: in / edge / out / unknown. A sticker of this area scanned just before counts as in. Never blocks the capture.

nodes.name: Photo to file
nodes.notes:
Base64 from the page → a file.
Guardrails: error-out

nodes.name: Store walk photo
nodes.notes:
Same bucket as WhatsApp evidence.
Guardrails: retry, error-out

nodes.name: Respond: try again
nodes.notes: Storage down: the page keeps the capture and retries.

nodes.name: Save capture and line

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [($('Photo to file').item.json.mobilisation_id) ?? null, ($('Photo to file').item.json.body.line) ?? null, ($('Photo to file').item.json.body.capture_id) ?? null, ($('Photo to file').item.json.s3_key) ?? null, (JSON.stringify($('Photo to file').item.json.body.gps || null)) ?? null, (JSON.stringify($('Photo to file').item.json.geo)) ?? null, ($('Photo to file').item.json.body.remark || '') ?? null, ($('Photo to file').item.json.engineer_id) ?? null, ($('Photo to file').item.json.body.status) ?? null] }}

nodes.notes:
The line was chosen before the shutter: binding is certain. Status is the engineer's own.
Guardrails: error-out, idempotent, audit, retry

nodes.name: Respond saved

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, line: $json.code, status: $json.status, geo: $('Place on site map').item.json.geo } }}

nodes.notes: The page shows "inside Labour camp" or "38 m outside: are you in the right area?"

nodes.name: Voice remark attached?
nodes.notes: Voice is transcribed after the page has its answer.

nodes.name: Voice to file
nodes.notes: Base64 → audio file.

nodes.name: Transcribe remark
nodes.notes:
Original words kept; English comes in the report.
Guardrails: retry, error-out

nodes.name: Save remark transcript

parameters.query: update evidence set transcript = coalesce(transcript || ' ', '') || $2, transcript_lang = $3 where capture_id = $1::uuid returning id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [($('Voice to file').item.json.capture_id) ?? null, ($json.transcript || '[voice remark: transcription failed, listen in Vera]') ?? null, ($json.language_code || '') ?? null] }}

nodes.notes:
If transcription failed, the report says so.
Guardrails: retry

nodes.name: Save trail points
nodes.notes:
Batches of GPS points every 20 s while the page is open. Duplicates ignored.
Guardrails: error-out, idempotent, retry

nodes.name: Respond 204
nodes.notes: No body.

nodes.name: Mark walk finished

parameters.query: update walks set finished_at = coalesce(finished_at, now()) where id = $1 returning mobilisation_id;

nodes.notes:
Once only.
Guardrails: error-out, idempotent

nodes.name: Respond 202

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "ok": true, "message": "Report is being drafted. It will come on WhatsApp." } }}

nodes.notes: The page can close.

nodes.name: Draft the NOC report
nodes.notes: WF-06 runs in the background.

nodes.name: Areas for marking

parameters.query: select w.id as walk_id, w.mobilisation_id, (select json_agg(distinct area) from lines where mobilisation_id = w.mobilisation_id) as areas from walks w where w.id = $1;

nodes.notes:
Which areas this site has.
Guardrails: error-out, retry

nodes.name: Check the area shape
nodes.notes:
Known area, 3–30 corners or a 5–150 m circle, GPS ±30 m or better, a sane size.
Guardrails: schema

nodes.name: Shape OK?
nodes.notes:
Bad shapes get a 400 with the reasons.
Guardrails: schema

nodes.name: Save area shape

parameters.query:
with w as (select mobilisation_id, engineer_id from walks where id = $1),
d as (delete from zones z using w where z.mobilisation_id = w.mobilisation_id and z.area = $2 returning z.id),
i as (insert into zones (mobilisation_id, area, name, shape, source) select w.mobilisation_id, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, 'engineer_drawn' from w returning id),
a as (insert into audit_log (actor, action, entity, entity_id, detail) select 'contact:' || w.engineer_id, 'mark_area', 'zone', $2, json_build_object('shape', $4::jsonb, 'replaced', (select count(*) from d)) from w)
select (select count(*) from i) as saved, (select count(*) from d) as replaced;

nodes.notes:
The engineer's shape replaces the contractor's pin for that area. The old one stays in the audit log.
Guardrails: error-out, audit

nodes.name: Respond area saved
nodes.notes: The page draws it at once.

nodes.name: Respond bad shape
nodes.notes: The page says why (usually: GPS too weak, wait and try again).

nodes.name: Check sticker
nodes.notes:
The code is signed: a made-up or altered code fails here.
Guardrails: auth

nodes.name: Sticker genuine?
nodes.notes: Only signed codes count.

nodes.name: Record sticker scan

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [($json.walk_id) ?? null, ($json.spot.area) ?? null, ($json.spot.sticker) ?? null, ($json.body.client_ts || '') ?? null, (JSON.stringify($json.body.gps || null)) ?? null, ($json.spot.mobilisation_id) ?? null] }}

nodes.notes:
Kept with time and GPS. A sticker from another site records nothing.
Guardrails: error-out, audit, idempotent

nodes.name: Respond sticker

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: !!$json.area, area: $json.area || null, message: $json.area ? 'Sticker recorded' : 'This sticker belongs to another site' } }}

nodes.notes: The page switches to that area.

nodes.name: Respond bad sticker

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "error": "validation_error", "details": ["This is not a Vera sticker for this site"] } }}

nodes.notes: Refused.

nodes.name: Areas for stickers

parameters.query:
select w.id as walk_id, w.mobilisation_id, mo.project, (select json_agg(distinct area) from lines where mobilisation_id = w.mobilisation_id and "when" = 'walk') as areas
from walks w join mobilisations mo on mo.id = w.mobilisation_id where w.id = $1;

nodes.notes:
The areas walked on this site.
Guardrails: error-out, retry

nodes.name: Sign sticker codes
nodes.notes:
One signed code per sticker (default 4 per area).
Guardrails: auth

nodes.name: Respond stickers
nodes.notes: The page prints them as QR codes, A4.

nodes.name: Respond 500
nodes.notes: Any step that breaks still answers the page, so it keeps the capture and retries.
